text:
Anna L: quick heads-up — large prospect just sent a "kitchen-sink" ask: wants a single package that includes dedicated throughput, unlimited burst, on-prem hooks, and a contract clause for capacity exemptions. asking product for a readiness checklist to evaluate whether we can offer a controlled "everything" pack for pilots. 

Mike R: i can own the pricing impacts. need rough workload numbers though — qps during peak, avg token/sec. without that it's just guesses.

Raj P: legal will push back on "unlimited" burst. we need a liability and damage cap, plus clear cap enforcement semantics. cc @Jeff B for suggested contract language.

Sophia K: docs concern — users will expect examples and entitlements table. if we ship a single sku that bundles everything, we must show combos and failure modes (what happens when burst is throttled). i can draft the one-pager.

Jeff B: legal quick take: we can't accept an open-ended exemption. propose: soft-cap + explicit escape-hatch + SLA tiers. something like: 

```
SLA_PROPOSAL:
- availability: 99.9% (hosted)
- committed_throughput: X RPS (negotiated)
- burst_policy: up to 2x committed for up to 1 hour/day (monthly)
- exemption_clause: explicit written approval required for > 2x sustained usage; automatic throttling until approval
- liability: capped at fees paid in last 12 months
```

Jeff B: i'll draft a short clause we can attach as an exhibit.

Anna L: proposed launch-readiness checklist (draft):
1) sku/price defined (Mike)
2) docs + entitlements table (Sophia)
3) legal exhibit + exemption wording (Jeff)
4) product flag + telemetry for burst enforcement (ops)
5) billing/invoicing hook + overage surcharge (Mike)
6) go/no-go criteria signed by AE + Legal + PM (Anna)

Mike R: sounds good. for pricing we should model 3 scenarios: conservative (low burst), expected (typical), high (rare sustained). i'll do a quick model by EOD. can someone give me estimates for expected burst frequency?

Raj P: we should also add contract gating: no on-prem + unlimited burst in pilot without SOC review. add to checklist.

Sophia K: i'll put the entitlements table template in the docs repo and link it here once done. also want a small FAQ to explain "escape hatch" to customers.

ops-bot: feature-flag "kitchen_sink_burst" created in staging. config: {"default": false, "owner": "product"}

Anna L: ops — can you confirm telemetry: we need per-customer 1m granularity metrics for token/sec, 95th percentile windows, and an alert when sustained >2x committed for >30m.

ops-bot: noted — will create alert: "burst-exceeding-2x-30m" and a dashboard tile. ETA 24h.

Mike R: +1 to the checklist. i'll attach the pricing models once ready.

Jeff B: i'll post the contract exhibit draft in #legal later today.

Anna L: ok — next steps: Mike (pricing model), Jeff (legal exhibit), Sophia (docs page + FAQ), Ops (telemetry + flag). i'll coordinate AE expectations and calendar a 30m sign-off on Friday. thanks all. :thumbsup:
